verses.en: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
verses.sm: Tupu e, ma lo‘u Atua, ia e feafofoga mai i le leo o laʻu alaga.

verses.en: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
verses.sm: aua on te talotalo atu ja te oe. Le ALII e, e faafofogaina e oe loʻu leo i le taeao;

verses.en: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
verses.sm: o le taeao ou te sauni atu ai la‘u tatalo ia te oe, ma ou vaavaai. Auā o 02, e te le se Atua e fiafia i le amio leaga;

verses.en: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
verses.sm: e le mau faatasi ma oe le ua fai mea leaga. E le tutii i ou luma o e faamaualuluga ;

verses.en: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
verses.sm: ua e “ino'ino ia i latou uma o e fai amio leaga. E fano ia te oe o e tala pepelo;

verses.en: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
verses.sm: e matuā inosia e le ALII le tagata ua totolima ma le tau‘ole‘ole. A e peitai a‘u nei,

verses.en: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
verses.sm: o le tele o lou alofa ou te alu atu ai i lou fale, ou te ifo i lou malumalu paia ma le mata'u ia te oe. Le ALII e, ia e ta‘ita‘i mai ia te au i lau amiotonu,

verses.en: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
verses.sm: ona o e ita mai ia te au; ia e fsasa‘o i oʻu luma lou ala.

verses.en: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
verses.sm: Aua e leai se faamaoni i o latou gutu; o lato i loto foi, ua matuā leaga; ua se tuugamau ua faamaga o latou faai; ua faaoleole i latou i o latou laulaufaiva.

verses.en: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
verses.sm: Le Atua e, ia e faasalaina i latou; ia pauu i latou i a latou lava taupulepulega; ia e tuliesea i latou ona o le tele o latou solitulafono; aua ua latou fouvale ia te oe.

verses.en: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
verses.sm: A ia fiafia i latou uma o e faatuatua ia te oe; ia latou alalaga fiafia e faavavau, aua e te faamamaluina i latou; ia olioli foi ia te oe o e alolofa i lou suafa.

verses.en: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
verses.sm: Auā o oe, le AL11 e, e te faamanuia i le ua amiotonu; e puipuia o ia e oe i le alofa, e pei o le tali pupuni.
